decisionMemo.businessProblem: A specialty home goods retailer faces a critical profitability challenge: gross margin has declined 400 basis points over two years while operating expenses have grown, compressing EBITDA margin from 9.1% to 6.2%. Physical store traffic is declining 12% YoY despite stable customer count, suggesting lower visit frequency or smaller basket sizes. Simultaneously, e-commerce growth (18% YoY) is not offset the margin decline in stores because digital channel orders have lower average value and higher acquisition costs. The core question: Is the margin erosion driven by (a) competitive pricing pressure requiring overall margin recovery strategy, (b) store traffic shift to e-commerce requiring omnichannel repositioning, (c) operational inefficiency in physical stores, (d) product-mix shift to lower-margin categories, or (e) a combination of factors requiring multi-dimensional intervention? The owner must identify and act within 7 months or face board pressure for restructuring.
